messages:
Alex (oncall): Heads-up — we're seeing a sustained surge hitting dedicated-eu-west1 GPU pool. Admission controller started returning throttles ~15m ago, customers on Dedicated are getting 429/503. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.local/pools/dedicated-eu-west1

Maya (sre): Yikes. Any queue/backlog numbers?

Alex (oncall): qlgt shows prefix queue length jumped from ~200 -> ~3k. Runtime logs show soft_reject at 95% util. Snippet:
```
[2025-11-03T09:12:43Z] pool=dedicated-eu-west1 gpu_util=0.96 qlen=3124 admit=reject reason=soft_admission
[2025-11-03T09:13:01Z] runtime: evicting small-batches due to memfrag, accept_rate=0.42
```

Jordan (eng-runtime): Looking. We pushed soft admit at 0.95 to avoid OOMs after last incident — looks like combined seq-length spike + KV cache pressure is pushing GPU memory above safe margin. Are these long context jobs?

Alex (oncall): Yes, several customers ran long chat sessions (>=8k tokens) + streaming. Also some large rerank jobs queued.

Lina (ops): Region capacity chart shows two preemptible nodes went away in the past hour (maintenance). Autoscaler hasn't replaced them yet due to AZ quota. Trying manual request to cloud for immediate replacement.

deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started: runtime/1.9.2 -> runtime/1.9.3 (hotfix for kv-cache leak)

Maya (sre): Immediate mitigation: 1) Suspend long-context customers on Dedicated by applying per-customer rate cap for the pool, 2) Reroute non-Dedicated traffic to hosted endpoints where possible, 3) Scale up pool if cloud quota allows. I can apply per-route rate caps via control plane.

Jordan (eng-runtime): Agree. Also can temporarily raise soft_admit threshold to 97% to reduce rejects, but that increases OOM risk. Prefer per-customer throttles + redirect.

Alex (oncall): Applying per-customer caps now for top 5 tenants in that pool (reducing concurrency and max_tokens). Patch command I used:
```
rwctl routes update --pool dedicated-eu-west1 --filter tenant:top5 --concurrency 2 --max-tokens 2048
```

Maya (sre): Done. I also created a quick admission-probe to divert best-effort reranks to hosted: `router set-fallback --pool dedicated-eu-west1 --tag best-effort hosted-eu`

Lina (ops): Cloud quota request submitted (support ticket #CLOUD-8731). Meanwhile manually started 2 spare nodes in us-west temporarily and added them to a cross-region burst pool using `rk pool attach --from us-west2 --to eu-west1-burst --nodes 2`. Network egress added ~110ms but better than throttles.

Alex (oncall): Good work. Customer-facing notes? Any active incidents reported?

Maya (sre): I've opened incident: https://incidents.redwood/in/INC-2025-1103-dedicated-surge. Status: Degraded. Notified top 10 Dedicated customers via support (templated message).

Jordan (eng-runtime): On the runtime side I rolled a config to add more aggressive KV eviction for long sequences (PR 4821). Will monitor memory headroom. Also enabling debug logging for memfrag buckets for 30m.

Alex (oncall): Observability: 429 rate dropped by 60% after caps + reroute, qlen down to ~600. Metrics:
```
09:40 qlen=632 admit_reject_rate=0.22 gpu_util=0.91
09:52 qlen=210 admit_reject_rate=0.08 gpu_util=0.86
```

Lina (ops): Cloud replaced one preemptible node, queued the permanent replacement. Burst nodes from us-west draining now. Will detach when healthy.

Maya (sre): Postmortem actions I'm adding: - Add automatic cross-region burst policy for Dedicated when qlen>1k for >5m; - Improve alerting to trigger before soft_admit flips; - Add tenant-level long-context detection to proactively cap in Dedicated.

Jordan (eng-runtime): Also propose runtime change: make soft_admit threshold dynamic based on observed memfrag and seq-length percentiles, not just static util. Will draft PR.

Alex (oncall): Customers mostly stable. Keeping this thread open until all nodes healthy and qlen <100 for 15m. Thanks everyone.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2025-1103 updated: status -> monitoring.

Maya (sre): Marking follow-up: schedule runbook update to include step to perform `router set-fallback` for best-effort workloads.

Alex (oncall): Closing loop: last check 10:18 qlen=42 gpu_util=0.59. I'll file postmortem draft later today.

Jordan (eng-runtime): Noted. I'll include perf traces from the memory leak probe.

Lina (ops): Ticket CLOUD-8731 resolved by cloud; quota increased.

Maya (sre): Thanks team :thumbsup:
